en.shaykh-tahir-ridha-jaffer: 23.Faḍālah narrated from ʿAbdullāh ibn Bukayr, from Abū Baṣīr, from Abū Jaʿfar (a) who said, “The Messenger of Allah (ṣ) used to say in his sermon, ‘Cursing a believer is transgression and fighting him is disbelief. Consuming his property [without permission] is a sin and his property is as inviolable as his blood.’”
